The baseline step loaded only 1992-01-01 to 1992-01-10, so only days of year 1-15 got non-NaN domain-wide thresholds. Smoothing leaves the summer (day-of-year 152-243) thresholds NaN, so no baseline SST value reaches the saved mask. Every target-day SST value of each sea cell from 2005-06-01 to 2005-08-31 still enters the hot-day test (isnan and >= threshold) at C6:L305, which always evaluates False; the run-extension step then gives an all-zero mask."}
